newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia considers pre-war bond redemptions - paper.
newsitem.headline: Estonia considers pre-war bond redemptions - paper.

text.p: Estonia is trying to decide whether to pay out a possible 242 million kroons plus interest for the redemption of bonds issued in 1927, Aripaev newspaper said on Monday.
The newspaper said the bonds were issued when Estonia was first independent from Russia between 1918 to 1940, the year it was annexed by the former Soviet Union.
The amount issued at the time was 700,000 pounds sterling plus four million dollars and carried a maturity of 1967.
It said an U.S. investor wanted to know whether the government intended to redeem the paper.
Last weekend, the issue was dicussed by Finance Minister Mart Opmann, Foreign Minister Toomas Ilves and central bank chief Vahur Kraft, Aripaev said.
No decision was announced and the newspaper quoted a government spokesman as saying the issue was still under consideration.
